en: Respect the privacy of research participants
Explore the subject area: industry publications, websites and social media, interviews
Develop a problem statement: define purpose, identify conclusion, phrase the problem as a question

Bangunkan pernyataan masalah: tentukan tujuan, kenal pasti kesimpulan, bingkai masalah sebagai soalan

en: Constraints: limited time, limited money, unavailability of qualified subjects
Information: limit the scope of surveys and interviews; “need to know” questions come before “nice to know” questions

Maklumat: hadkan skop tinjauan dan temu bual; soalan “need to know” sebelum “nice to know”

Are all claims supported with evidence?
Do claims stand up to logical scrutiny?

Monitoring: subscribe to news feeds, follow people on Twitter, create alerts, use specialised monitors

Pemantauan: langgan suapan berita, ikut orang di Twitter, cipta amaran, guna pemantau khusus

en: Look beyond the first few pages
Shows sufficient support for your message
Helps readers explore the topic in more detail
ms: Memberi kredit sewajarnya kepada pencipta asal
Membantu pembaca meneroka topik lebih lanjut

title.ms: Penyelidikan Primer: Tinjauan dan Temu Bual

en: Must be **reliable**: produces identical results when repeated
Must be **valid**: measures what it is intended to measure
Choose participants carefully: get a representative sample of the population
Use a research handbook or hire a research specialist
ms: Mesti **boleh dipercayai (reliable)**: hasil sama bila diulang
Mesti **sah (valid)**: mengukur apa yang sepatutnya diukur
Pilih peserta dengan teliti: sampel mewakili populasi
Guna buku panduan penyelidikan atau upah pakar

en: Ask for information people can remember
Formulate questions that are easy to analyse
ms: Tanya maklumat yang orang boleh ingat

en: Question types: open-ended, closed; plan question sequence
ms: Jenis soalan: terbuka, tertutup; rancang urutan soalan
Jenis temu bual: dirakam, bersemuka, kumpulan

en: Restating it in your own words
Similar to paraphrasing; presents the gist in fewer words
ms: Serupa parafrasa; bentang intipati dengan lebih sedikit perkataan

en: Don’t push results beyond their limits

blocks.en: Slide 30 (Analyzing Numeric Data) has no text.

en: Do not include opinions, conclusions or recommendations
Identify the main idea and key support points
ms: Jangan sertakan pendapat, kesimpulan atau cadangan
Kenal pasti idea utama dan poin sokongan

en: Based strictly on the information in your report (no new information)
Logical: follows accepted patterns of inductive or deductive reasoning; use appropriate assumptions, judgment calls and creative thinking
ms: Berdasarkan sepenuhnya maklumat dalam laporan (tiada maklumat baru)
Logik: ikut corak penaakulan induktif atau deduktif; guna andaian, pertimbangan dan pemikiran kreatif sesuai

en: Based on logical analysis and sound conclusions
ms: Berdasarkan analisis logik dan kesimpulan kukuh

q.en: Six ethics and etiquette rules for research?

a.en: Don’t force an outcome, respect participant privacy, document sources, respect IP rights, don’t misquote, don’t misrepresent.
a.ms: Jangan paksa hasil, hormati privasi, dokumen sumber, hormati harta intelek, jangan salah petik, jangan salah nyata.

q.en: Three research constraints?

a.en: Limited time, limited money, unavailability of qualified subjects.
a.ms: Masa terhad, wang terhad, ketiadaan subjek berkelayakan.

q.en: Need-to-know vs nice-to-know?

a.en: Prioritise “need to know” questions over “nice to know” to limit scope.
a.ms: Utamakan “need to know” berbanding “nice to know” untuk hadkan skop.

q.en: Name five questions for evaluating a source.

a.en: Honest/reliable? Biased? Purpose? Author credible? Source of information? Verifiable? Current? Complete? Evidence? Logic?
a.ms: Jujur/boleh dipercayai? Berat sebelah? Tujuan? Penulis berwibawa? Sumber? Boleh disahkan? Terkini? Lengkap? Bukti? Logik?

q.en: Internal vs external resources?

a.en: Internal: documents, knowledge management system, research repository. External: print/online resources, reference librarian, public reports.
a.ms: Dalam: dokumen, sistem pengurusan pengetahuan, repositori. Luar: sumber cetak/dalam talian, pustakawan, laporan awam.

q.en: Pros and cons of general-purpose search engines?
q.ms: Kelebihan dan kekurangan enjin carian umum?

a.en: Pros: ranked by usefulness, millions of pages, powerful algorithms. Cons: no human editors, no uniform techniques, can’t reach deep web.
a.ms: Kelebihan: kedudukan mengikut kegunaan, jutaan halaman, algoritma kuat. Kekurangan: tiada penyunting, teknik tidak seragam, tiada deep web.

q.en: Name four improved online search tools.
q.ms: Namakan empat alat carian lebih baik.

a.en: Web directories, metasearch engines, online databases, specialised search engines.
a.ms: Direktori web, enjin metacarian, pangkalan data dalam talian, enjin carian khusus.

q.en: Online monitoring tools?

a.en: Subscribe to news feeds, follow people on Twitter, create alerts, specialised monitors.
a.ms: Langgan suapan, ikut orang di Twitter, cipta amaran, pemantau khusus.

q.en: Three functions of documenting sources?

a.en: Credits originator, shows support for message, helps readers explore more.
a.ms: Beri kredit pencipta, tunjuk sokongan, bantu pembaca meneroka.

q.en: Reliable vs valid survey?

a.en: Reliable: identical results when repeated. Valid: measures what it is intended to measure.
a.ms: Reliable: hasil sama bila diulang. Valid: mengukur apa yang sepatutnya.

q.en: Four survey writing tips?

a.en: Clear instructions, ask what people can remember, keep short, easy-to-analyse questions.
a.ms: Arahan jelas, tanya yang diingat, pendek, soalan mudah dianalisis.

q.en: Four things to avoid in survey questions?
q.ms: Empat perkara dielak dalam soalan tinjauan?

a.en: Leading questions, ambiguous descriptors, compound questions; make survey adaptive.
a.ms: Soalan mengarah, penerang kabur, soalan majmuk; jadikan adaptif.

q.en: Open-ended vs closed questions?

a.en: Two interview question types listed on slide 26.
a.ms: Dua jenis soalan temu bual pada slaid 26.

q.en: Three types of interviews?

a.en: Recorded, face-to-face, group.
a.ms: Dirakam, bersemuka, kumpulan.

q.en: Quoting, paraphrasing, summarising?

a.en: Quote exactly; paraphrase in own words; summarise the gist in fewer words.
a.ms: Petik tepat; parafrasa dengan perkataan sendiri; ringkas intipati.

q.en: Four insight terms for numeric data?

a.en: Trends, causation, correlation, cross-tabulation.
a.ms: Trend, kausaliti, korelasi, tabulasi silang.

q.en: Five mistakes to guard against?

a.en: Computational errors, misrepresenting results, faulty comparisons, pushing results beyond limits, misleading presentations.
a.ms: Kesilapan pengiraan, salah nyata hasil, perbandingan cacat, melebihi had, pembentangan mengelirukan.

q.en: What should a research summary NOT include?
q.ms: Apa tidak patut ada dalam ringkasan penyelidikan?

a.en: Opinions, conclusions or recommendations.
a.ms: Pendapat, kesimpulan atau cadangan.

q.en: Two criteria for conclusions?

a.en: Based strictly on the report’s information; logical (inductive or deductive reasoning).
a.ms: Berdasarkan maklumat laporan; logik (induktif atau deduktif).

q.en: Four qualities of recommendations?

a.en: Suggest what to do, based on sound conclusions, practical and acceptable, describe steps adequately.
a.ms: Cadang apa dibuat, berdasarkan kesimpulan kukuh, praktikal dan diterima, huraikan langkah.
